summary: Rows are self-consistent (lint 0 failures, make-rows-r3 reproduces revolve-groove.json byte-for-byte in a scratch copy, 13 live replays match stored numbers). But the lip-graze guard G10 only fires for a target proven to be a plain box or cylinder, and a groove with a ring edge 0.05 mm short of the top face of a frustum (spin target) builds silently with a missing planar face (area -5.4 percent, volume 3.3e-4 over the 3e-4 bar), so the claimed 'never a silently wrong solid' has a hole.

defects.problem: grazing() runs only when certifiedShape() proves a plain box or cylinder. A groove with its ring end 0.05 mm short of a face of any other part (a frustum from spin, probably also a tube, a box with a hole, an L-shape) is not refused by any guard (G8 allows a part turn with one curved face that does not reach the wall; G9 and G10 need a certified shape) and builds with a missing planar face (area -5.4 percent, volume 3.3e-4 off the closed form, OCCT 8 faces vs truck 7). The same lip on a post or box is refused. This is a silent wrong solid; the contract states the guard only for plain box/post.
defects.evidenceFile: scratch: critic-revolve-groove/out/crit-cone-lip005-180.json and crit-cone-lip005-90.json; guard: contract/revolve-groove.guard.mjs grazing(), certifiedShape(), costRefusal()

defects.problem: The curved-volume bar is max(3e-4, 1.5e-4 x thin-ring amplification); the worst fuzz member sf5-27-top--90 passes at dVol 7.6e-4 (replayed). The error is truck tessellation versus Pappus, plausible, but the bar grows with an amplification factor chosen after seeing the data.
The sentence can render 'passes within 0 mm of a flat face' for a tangent wall (num() rounds gap), which reads oddly though it is one plain sentence without engine words.
